description: Stratified coursework candidate scenarios for M4 ranking integration.

selection.method: First ten agent IDs in ascending order; four source-linked policies and six source-linked clients per scenario, with stratified synthetic action contexts and explicit filter controls

field_lineage.synthetic_record_notice: Customer and policy records are coursework demonstration records. Candidate identity, premium and ownership are source-linked; action context and displayed policy status are stratified synthetic evaluation evidence, not individual Kaggle records or production facts.

transformation_rules.policy_expected_contribution: premium multiplied by the agent historical conversion rate
transformation_rules.client_expected_contribution: client premium multiplied by the agent retention rate
transformation_rules.business_fit: Base 0.4 plus product-specialty, need-category, and high-value matches, capped at 1
transformation_rules.eligibility: The scenario has a current action and positive premium where applicable
transformation_rules.permission: Same tenant/agent ownership plus scenario contact permission
transformation_rules.compliance: Agent and scenario product-compliance gates permit contact

limitations: Expected contribution is a transparent rule-based estimate, not a trained probability prediction.
Final M4 relevance labels are collected independently from blinded human rankings and are not generated here.
